info.title: Avzar API
info.description: A route skeleton generated from the source by backend-node/scripts/generate-api-doc.js. It lists every route, its method, path parameters, who may call it (x-access, x-permissions) and the generic error responses. It has no request or response schemas: for those, read the route file. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run docs:api`.

Unauthorized.description: Not signed in, or the session has ended.

NotFound.description: No such record in this business.

TooLarge.description: An export is limited to 50,000 rows; narrow the filters.
